title: Wolves in the Wood
description: Dire wolves have had the western camp three weeks. They killed Corin Talbot and one more, and the men still standing will not go back out. Tharin cannot lose another before the snow.

objectives.description: Learn about the wolf problem from Tharin Ironbeard
Travel to the western logging camp
Investigate where the two woodsmen died
Track the wolf pack to their den

notes: Named one of the two dead woodsmen (Corin Talbot, invented for this quest only, prose colour). Distinct from tharins_wolf_problem (ordinary wolves, the road, a trust test) by threat, cause and location - dire wolves, a den in the western forest, fatalities already happened here.
